_comment: Tier-2 for febio::hyperelasticity#1. Four runs on the shipped cube at fixed t_end: neo-Hookean converges in ONE load step at 50% and at 300% nominal strain, so the "10 substeps past 10% strain" rule of thumb is wrong by orders of magnitude for a coupled material; Mooney-Rivlin fails in one step at 100% with 'N negative jacobians detected.' and converges in TWO. That last pair is the claim in one comparison — the failure is real, substeps are the fix, and the threshold is material-dependent and nowhere near 10%. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
